summary: Pull request successfully removes all self-update logic from Grove as per issue #247. All 9 acceptance criteria verified: (1) internal/updater package (525 lines + 402 test lines) deleted, (2) update modal implementation removed, (3) updater/version imports cleaned from cmd/grove/app.go and main.go, (4) checkForUpdateCmd converted to no-op placeholder, (5) latestVersion/selfUpdating model fields removed, (6) renderView updated to remove update overlay, (7) UpdateConfirmedMsg type and handler removed, (8) CONTRIBUTING.md project layout updated, (9) README and CHANGELOG documentation updated. Package-lock.json change fixes inconsistency from PR #245 by adding missing grove-lab entry. All tests pass (13 packages), build succeeds, no vet issues, formatting corrected.
reviewedAreas: Code organization: internal/updater/ package deleted with all functions removed (CheckLatestRelease, SelfUpdate, replaceBinary, extractFromTarGz, verifyChecksum, stageBinary, CleanupOldBinary etc.)
Type definitions: updateCheckedMsg, selfUpdateDoneMsg types converted to no-op; ReleaseInfo, PermissionError types removed from app.go
Message handling: UpdateConfirmedMsg type deleted from internal/tui/modal/messages.go; update modal handlers removed from app.go Update() function
Model state: latestVersion and selfUpdating fields removed from Model struct
UI rendering: renderView() updated to remove selfUpdating overlay case; activeModal handles all modals now
Import cleanup: updater and version imports removed from cmd/grove/app.go and cmd/grove/main.go; CleanupOldBinary() call removed from main.go

Test coverage: internal/updater/updater_test.go deleted (402 lines); internal/tui/modal/update_test.go deleted (98 lines); app_test.go regression test for update modal removed - no other tests affected

Documentation: .github/CONTRIBUTING.md project layout updated; CHANGELOG.md released note added under Removed section; README.md Staying Up to Date section rewritten with platform installer commands and build instructions
Build validation: go test ./... passes all 13 packages; go vet reports no issues; gofmt formatting applied; go build ./cmd/grove succeeds
The package-lock.json change is a corrective fix for an existing inconsistency from PR #245 where grove-lab was added to package.json but not synced to package-lock.json
fixes: Formatting correction: field spacing in updateCheckedMsg struct fixed via gofmt -w cmd/grove/app.go
validation: go test ./... -count=1 passed all 13 packages; go build ./cmd/grove succeeded; go vet ./... reported no issues
residualRisks: None - all acceptance criteria satisfied; breaking change (no self-update) is documented in CHANGELOG with migration path via platform installers and source builds
